hay: File:Traditional_fishing_festival_46.jpg The fishing festival is one of the old traditional festivals in Bangladesh. Hundreds of villagers and fishermen take part in this festival spontaneously with bamboo-made fishing tools, in knee-deep water forgetting their woes of the summer.
